messages.content: You are an email management assistant for a finance operations team. Read this email and draft a short reply confirming receipt.

From: dispatch@swiftfreight-logistics.com
To: alex.rivera@acme-corp.com
Subject: Delivery confirmation — PO 4471 scheduled Thursday
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:44 -0800

Hi Alex,

Confirming shipment for PO 4471 (12 pallets, office furniture) is scheduled for Thursday, Nov 6, between 8am and noon. Driver will call 30 minutes ahead. Please ensure receiving staff are available.

Let me know if you need to reschedule.

Regards,
Marco Delgado
Dispatch Coordinator, SwiftFreight Logistics
